title: 第十三章 清洞疗愈复 神体再归元第十四章 魔主临尘宇 邪尊撼天道

;;
玄毒凶蚁之患既平，石洞之内浊气尽散，草木清灵之气萦绕四野，温润纯粹，不复往日阴湿幽暗。
花月初布下的草木灵阵恒久流转，青碧光霭淡淡覆满洞内，净化地气，隔绝阴浊，更有缕缕花草生机灵韵，昼夜不息漫溢周遭，化作天然养愈道场。何日封死地底蚁穴入口，以骄阳余温烘燥崖壁裂隙，扫清残蚁余孽，洞外山林亦被他巡守得安稳清净，再无虫豸妖邪敢靠近石洞半步。
风波暂歇，尘嚣远隔，恰好给何年、何月二人留得一段安稳静养之机。
何月自遭玄毒凶蚁暗中噬咬，阴毒潜于经脉，扰及月华流转，又本就神基受黑风古妖王重创，本源亏虚，经蚁毒一扰，身子更添孱弱。自蚁患平息后，她敛神静坐石床，心安意宁，再不被外相惊扰。
花月初依旧寸步不离，每日引洞外灵花仙草之精，萃成纯粹生机灵露，渡入何月体内。草木主生发、和阴阳、涤阴浊，灵露顺着月华经脉缓缓游走，一点点消融残存蚁毒余绪，抚平被煞气与蚁毒双重侵蚀的脉络裂痕，温养动荡飘摇的神府根基。
何年亦端坐另一侧石榻，默念《六千字文》时序真经，周身莹白光韵周行不息。他以时序大道之力，缓缓梳理周身经脉，一边消解玄毒凶蚁留在肌理的麻涩余毒，一边压制掌心旧伤与体内潜伏的暗影魔毒。时序主枯荣、定生机、镇邪祟，经文流转之间，岁月沉淀之力浸养神魂，将魔毒、蚁毒层层分隔、缓缓消融，不令两股阴邪之气再行勾连作祟。
洞中岁月静谧无波，无昼夜喧嚣，无魔妖惊扰，唯有灵气潺潺流转，四人各守其责，安然度日。
白日，山光透过洞口古木枝叶缝隙，洒落细碎金斑，落在石地之上，暖意融融。花月初静坐二人中间，闭目调息之余，时时分出一缕灵念，观照二人气机起伏，一旦察觉灵气滞涩、心绪微躁，便即刻渡入清和灵韵，为之疏导平复。
何日依旧守在洞口，半倚石壁，骄阳神力内敛不发，神念铺展方圆数里，遍察山林气机。但凡有阴邪煞气微动、虫豸游走气息，皆逃不过他感知，一经察觉，便悄然出手驱散，绝不令半点隐患逼近石洞，惊扰二人清修。他经几番患难，心性愈发沉稳，不再往日莽撞跳脱，只默默守护，甘为屏障，护洞内一片安宁。
入夜，月华隐现，清辉漫过山崖，洒入洞内，与何月自身月华灵气暗暗相融，两相呼应。天地间清和月韵入体，更助她修补神基，涵养本源。她眉宇渐渐舒展，苍白面容一日日泛起温润血色，唇角浅淡的血色伤痕早已结痂褪去，虚弱倦怠之态悄然消散。
起初，她经脉尚有酸胀滞涩，神府偶有昏沉烦乱；三日之后，蚁毒余气彻底涤荡干净，蛮荒妖煞亦被草木灵韵与月华之力层层化解，经脉通泰无阻，灵气流转圆融自如。受损的神基在天地月华、草木生机、自身本源三重温养下，一点点稳固重塑，涣散的月华灵气尽数收拢归一，重新凝聚丹田神府之间。
她缓缓运转月华大道，银辉自周身隐隐泛起，柔和澄澈，比受伤之前更显温润醇厚。经这番重伤静养、劫难洗练，她非但伤势尽愈，反倒道心更进一层，懂得隐忍守心、顺天调息，慈悲之念更笃，月华道韵愈发圆融通透。
再观何年。
连日静坐参悟，时序经文与自身道心相合，流转周身不息。体内暗影魔毒被时序之力死死镇住，再无蚀魂乱脉之态；玄毒凶蚁留下的阴浊余毒早已消融殆尽，膝间腿间被咬的肌理全然复原，不留半点隐患。掌心被幽影魔将划伤的创口，在时序生机与草木灵露双重滋养下，皮肉愈合，经脉归序，只余淡淡一道浅痕，作为此番劫难留痕。
他心神愈发澄明，摒弃杂念，把古道遇妖、石洞遭袭、凶蚁噬体几番劫数，皆化作悟道之资。历劫的沉郁、护人的执念、暗藏的情愫，皆敛于心底，化作稳固道心、精进修为的助力。年神被封印的本源，在一次次疗伤、御敌、悟道之中，又悄然解封几分，周身时序道威内敛深沉，底蕴愈发厚重，举手投足间，自有岁月山河的沉稳气度。
待到第五日清晨，晨曦破雾，朝阳东升，金辉穿透林间晨雾，洒落山腰石洞。
洞内灵气陡然一振，清光四溢。
何月首先双目缓缓睁开，眸中月华澄澈如水，温润明净，再无半分虚弱黯淡。周身银辉淡淡萦绕，灵气流转顺畅圆融，神府稳固，本源归元，经脉通泰无恙，此番重伤、蚁患带来的亏耗，已然尽数补全，伤势彻底痊愈，修为不仅复原，反倒更有精进。
她起身缓步而立，身姿依旧温婉清雅，却多了几分历经劫波后的沉静通透，眉宇间慈悲不改，更添几分坚韧定力。

“休养多日，承蒙月初连日耗元疗愈，多谢兄长以时序灵气暗中护持，亦多谢三弟在外日夜巡守，为我挡尽外扰。”何月步履轻盈，行至二人身前，语气温和真挚，满心感念。
花月初闻言睁开双眸，浅浅含笑，眸光温润：“月神大道本就与天地月华同源，只需静心安养，自可归元复元。你我同行患难，彼此照应，何须言谢。”
就在此时，何年亦缓缓睁开双眼，眸色深邃平静，莹白时序灵光隐于眼底，周身气息沉稳如山，魔毒尽被压制蛰伏，伤势、蚁患、旧创全数平复，神体安康，道心稳固。
他抬眸望向何月，见她气色红润、眸光清亮，已然全然康复，心底悬着的大石终于落地，眉宇间泛起一抹宽慰之色，温声道：“见你神体复原，月华归元，便是最好。连日闭关，耽搁前路行程，也委屈你在此静守疗伤。”
“劫数使然，亦是修身悟道之缘。”何月淡然浅笑，“若不经此番伤情静养，亦难沉淀道心，稳固神基。此番虽滞行程，却也获益良多。”
何日听闻洞内动静，连忙从洞口走入，见何月神采复原、气息饱满，再无半分往日孱弱，顿时喜上眉梢，爽朗笑道：“太好了阿姐！总算是彻底痊愈了，这些日子我日日守在外面，一直记挂你的伤势，如今总算能放下心来！”
他又看向何年，仔细打量一番，见兄长气色平和、气息凝稳，再无先前中毒受伤的虚弱之态，更是欢喜：“兄长也全然恢复了，魔毒、蚁毒全都化解，这下我们四人，再无伤势牵绊，可以重新启程了！”
石洞之内，气氛豁然清朗，一扫往日伤病凝重之忧。
花月初抬手轻拂，周身草木灵韵微动，将洞内残留的浊气、病气尽数涤荡干净，灵阵缓缓收敛，回归自身灵府。“你二人皆已神体归元，伤势尽复，无需再在此洞久留。此地虽清幽宜居，却终究偏于一隅，非历劫驻足长久之地。天地浩劫未平，瘟魔遁走未灭，妖邪蛰伏山野，魔界暗袭不休，我等不宜再耽于静养，当择日整装，再踏征途。”
何年颔首认同，目光望向洞外连绵群山，神色渐归坚毅：“所言极是。我二人伤势已愈，神体复原，道心更稳，修为亦有暗进。石洞静养之恩已了，再留此处，徒耗光阴。前路魔影重重，劫波未歇，九瘟魔君未灭，黑风妖王遁走蓄势，幽影魔将暗藏暗处窥伺，我等更当早日启程，顺着古道往山川腹地而行，梳理地脉时序，救济四方苍生，寻机缘修补时序玉璧。”
何月温婉点头，眸中闪过坚定：“伤势已复，道心已宁，自当随众人再赴尘途。历经瘟疫、妖风、蚁患、魔袭，劫难虽苦，却也让我等羁绊更深，道心更坚。此后同行，更当彼此守望，共抗劫波。”
何日意气风发，周身金光微漾，已然按捺不住再度启程之心：“既已尽数康复，那我们便即刻整装，今日便离石洞，重走古道，往山川深处前行！有我等四人同心协力，纵使前路妖魔再强，也无惧一战！”
四人议定，不再迟疑。
花月初收整草木灵韵，感念此洞栖身疗伤之缘，淡淡敛衽致意；何年回望石洞，感念几日清修悟道、护养亲人之安，将此番劫遇默默藏于心道；何月静立片刻，平复心神，整装待发；何日率先迈步，踏出洞口，探看山林路况，清扫前路微末隐患。
走出石洞，晨雾散尽，山风清润，草木葱茏遍野，林间生机盎然。经多日灵气滋养、时序梳理，周遭山川时序渐稳，枯木逢春，鸟兽安宁，再无先前妖氛、瘟气、蚁患的阴浊肃杀之象。
四人并肩立于山腰，远眺前路蜿蜒古道，山峦层叠，云雾缥缈，前路依旧未知难测，劫机暗藏。
然此刻，何月神体痊愈，月华归元；何年伤势尽复，道心稳固；花月初灵韵依旧，初心不改；何日沉稳历练，锐气不减。四人皆无伤病牵绊，心神合一，大道相契，底气更足，信念更坚。
经石洞疗伤、凶蚁噬扰、魔将暗袭几番波折，四人同心羁绊愈发牢不可破，历劫悟道之心愈发纯粹坚定。
整装已毕，再别清幽石洞，转身迈步，循着古道向着山川腹地纵深而行，再度踏上历劫救世、补璧安天之途。
前路纵有千难万险、魔妖拦路，四人同心相伴，心怀苍生，坚守大道，自可一往无前，踏破万重劫波。

The infestation of mysterious poisonous ants has subsided, the turbid air in the cave has dissipated, and the clear and spiritual air of the vegetation lingers in the surrounding areas, which is warm and pure, and is no longer damp and dark as in the past.
The spiritual array of plants and trees laid out at the beginning of the month of flowers circulates forever, and the green light fills the cave, purifying the earth's atmosphere, isolating the turbidity, and the vitality of flowers and plants fills the surroundings day and night, turning it into a natural healing dojo. When the entrance to the underground ant nest was sealed, the remaining heat of the sun dried up the cracks in the cliff, and the remaining ants were swept away. The forest outside the cave was also patrolled by him to make it safe and clean. No insect, evil spirit dared to approach the cave.
The turmoil has subsided for a while, and the bustle is far away, which just gives He Nian and He Yue a chance to rest peacefully.
He Yue was secretly bitten by mysterious poisonous ants, and the sinister poison lurked in the meridians, disturbing the flow of moonlight. Moreover, his divine base was severely damaged by the Black Wind Ancient Demon King, and his origin was weakened. The ant poison disturbed his body, making his body even weaker. After the ant infestation subsided, she calmly sat down on the stone bed, calm and peaceful, and was no longer disturbed by outsiders.
Hua Yue still never leaves He Yue, drawing the essence of the spiritual flowers and fairy grass outside the cave every day, extracting it into pure vitality and spiritual dew, and passing it into He Yue's body. Plants and trees are responsible for hair growth, harmonizing yin and yang, and purifying yin and turbidity. The spiritual dew slowly swims along the moon meridians, melting away the remaining traces of ant poison little by little, smoothing the cracks in the veins that have been eroded by both evil spirits and ant poisons, and warming and nourishing the turbulent foundation of the divine palace.
He Nian also sat on the stone couch on the other side, silently reciting the "Six Thousand Character Essay" Time Sequence Sutra, and the white light around his body continued to circulate. He used the power of the Great Path of Time to slowly comb through the meridians all over his body, while eliminating the numbing poison left by the mysterious poisonous ants in his texture, and at the same time suppressing the old wounds on his palms and the shadow poison lurking in his body. The sequence of time governs withering and prosperity, stabilizing vitality, and suppressing evil spirits. As the scriptures circulate, the power of accumulation of time nourishes the soul, separates the evil poisons and ant poisons layer by layer, and slowly dissolves them, preventing the two evil spirits from connecting again to cause trouble.
The years in the cave were quiet and waveless, with no noise day and night, no disturbance from demons and monsters, only the gurgling flow of spiritual energy. The four people each abided by their responsibilities and lived peacefully.
During the day, the mountain light shines through the gaps between the branches and leaves of the ancient trees at the entrance of the cave, scattering fine golden spots and falling on the stone floor, creating a warm feeling. At the beginning of the month, she sat quietly between the two of them, closing her eyes and regulating her breath. She would send out a spiritual thought from time to time to observe the ups and downs of the two people's Qi. Once she noticed that the Qi of the two people was stagnant and their mood was agitated, she would immediately enter the pure and harmonious aura to calm it down.
Heri was still guarding the entrance of the cave, half leaning against the stone wall. The scorching sun's divine power was restrained, and his spiritual thoughts spread for miles around, observing the qi of the mountains and forests. Any slight movement of evil spirits or wandering insects cannot escape his perception. Once he notices it, he quietly dispels it, never letting the slightest hidden danger approach the cave and disturb the two men's cultivation. After going through several hardships, his mind became calmer and calmer. He no longer acted recklessly as before. He only guarded silently and was willing to act as a barrier to protect the peace in the cave.
At night, the moonlight looms, and the clear light spreads over the cliff and into the cave, blending quietly with He Yue's own moonlight aura, echoing the two. The pure harmony between heaven and earth entered her body, which helped her repair her divine foundation and nourish her origin. Her eyebrows gradually relaxed, and her pale face became warmer and bloodier day by day. The faint bloody scars on the corners of her lips had long since scabbed away, and her weakness and fatigue had quietly dissipated.
At first, her meridians were still sore, swollen, and astringent, and her body occasionally felt dizzy and agitated; after three days, the remaining ant poisonous energy was completely washed away, and the wild monsters were dissolved layer by layer by the aura of vegetation and moonlight. Her meridians were unobstructed, and the aura flowed smoothly and smoothly. The damaged divine base was gradually reshaped under the triple warmth of heaven and earth, moonlight, vegetation vitality, and its own origin. The scattered moonlight spiritual energy was gathered together and unified, and re-condensed between the dantian and the divine palace.
She slowly rotated the Moonlight Avenue, and the silver glow faintly appeared from her whole body, soft and clear, looking warmer and mellower than before the injury. After recuperating from serious injuries and training through tribulations, not only did her injuries completely heal, but her Taoist mind improved to a new level. She knew how to be forbearing and guarding her heart, regulate her breath in accordance with the heavens, her thoughts of compassion became stronger, and her moonlight Taoist charm became more harmonious and transparent.
Let’s look at what year.
Sitting quietly for days to meditate, time-series scriptures andThe Tao and the heart of oneself are in harmony, flowing around the body endlessly. The shadow poison in the body was firmly suppressed by the power of time sequence, and it no longer eroded the soul and messed up the veins; the turbid poison left by the black poisonous ants had long since melted away, and the texture of the bite between the knees and legs was completely restored, leaving no hidden dangers. The wound on the palm of the hand scratched by the Shadow Demon General was nourished by the vitality of time and the spiritual dew of vegetation. The skin and flesh healed, and the meridians returned to their order, leaving only a faint mark as a trace of this disaster.
His mind became clearer and clearer, and he abandoned distracting thoughts, turning the encounters with monsters on the ancient road, the attacks on the stone caves, and the vicious ants eating into his body into the resources for enlightenment. The depression of past calamities, the obsession to protect others, and the hidden emotions are all gathered in the bottom of my heart, turning into help to stabilize the Taoist heart and improve my cultivation. The sealed origin of the Nian God has been quietly unsealed a few times in the process of healing, fending off enemies, and enlightening the Tao. His body is introverted and profound, and his heritage is getting richer. His every move has the calm demeanor of the mountains and rivers of time.
In the early morning of the fifth day, the morning light broke through the fog, and the sun rose in the east. The golden light penetrated the morning fog in the forest and fell into the cave on the mountainside.
The spiritual energy in the cave suddenly vibrated, and clear light overflowed.
He Yue slowly opened her eyes first. The moonlight in her eyes was as clear as water, warm and bright, and no longer weak and dim. The silver glow lingers faintly around the body, the spiritual energy flows smoothly and harmoniously, the divine palace is stable, the origin is restored, and the meridians are intact. The losses caused by the serious injury and the ant infestation have been fully compensated, the injury is completely healed, and the cultivation level is not only restored, but also improved.
She stood up and stood slowly, her posture still gentle and elegant, but with a bit more calmness and transparency after going through the tribulation. The compassion in her brows remained unchanged, adding a bit more perseverance and determination.
"I have been resting for many days. Thanks to the continuous days spent on healing at the beginning of the month, I would like to thank my elder brother for protecting me secretly with the time-sequence spiritual energy. I would also like to thank my third brother for patrolling outside day and night to shield me from external disturbances." He Yue walked lightly and walked in front of the two of them. Her tone was gentle and sincere, full of gratitude.
When Hua Yue heard the words, she opened her eyes, smiled slightly, and said with gentle eyes: "The Moon God Avenue has the same origin as the moonlight of heaven and earth. As long as you calm down and take care of yourself, you can return to your original state. You and I walk together in adversity and take care of each other, so there is no need to say thank you."
At this moment, He Nian also slowly opened his eyes, his eyes were deep and calm, a crystal white aura was hidden in his eyes, the aura around his body was as calm as a mountain, all the demonic poisons were suppressed and dormant, all injuries, ant infestations, and old wounds were healed, his body was healthy, and his Taoist mind was stable.
He raised his eyes to look at He Yue, and saw that her complexion was rosy, her eyes were clear, and she had fully recovered. The big stone hanging in his heart finally fell to the ground, and a touch of relief appeared between his brows. He said warmly: "It would be best to see your body recover and Yuehua return to her original state. You have been in seclusion for many days, delaying the journey ahead, and I feel sorry for you to stay here to heal your injuries."
"The calamity dictates that it is also the fate of self-cultivation and enlightenment." He Yue smiled lightly, "If we don't rest through this injury, it will be difficult to settle down the Taoist heart and stabilize the divine foundation. Although this time is delayed, we have also benefited a lot."
He heard the movement in the cave and hurriedly walked in from the entrance. Seeing He Yue's energy restored and full of breath, no longer weak as before, he was immediately happy and said with a hearty smile: "It's great, sister! I have finally recovered completely. I have been staying outside these days, always thinking about your injury, and now I can finally feel relieved!"
He looked at He Nian again, looked carefully, and saw that his brother's complexion was calm, his breath was stable, and he was no longer as weak as before when he was poisoned and injured. He was even more happy: "Brother has fully recovered. The devil poison and ant poison have all been resolved. Now the four of us are no longer hindered by injuries and can start our journey again!"
Inside the cave, the atmosphere suddenly became clear, and the worries of previous injuries and seriousness were gone.
Hua Yue raised her hand and flicked it, and the aura of the vegetation around her body moved slightly, cleaning away all the turbid and sick air remaining in the cave. The spiritual array slowly converged and returned to its own spiritual home. "Both of you have returned to your original state, and your injuries have completely recovered. There is no need to stay in this cave for a long time. Although this place is quiet and livable, it is still in a corner, and it is not a place where you can stay for a long time. The catastrophe of heaven and earth has not been over, and the plagueThe devil has escaped and has not been extinguished, evil spirits are dormant in the mountains and fields, and the demon world is constantly attacking. It is not appropriate for us to rest in peace any longer. We should choose a day to get ready and start the journey again. "
He Nian nodded in agreement, looking at the mountains outside the cave, his expression gradually returning to determination: "What you said is absolutely true. Our injuries have healed, our spiritual bodies have recovered, our Taoist minds have become more stable, and our cultivation has also improved. The grace of resting in the cave is over. Staying here any longer will be a waste of time. There are many demonic shadows on the road ahead, the calamity wave has not stopped, the Nine Plague Demon King has not been destroyed, the Black Wind Demon King has escaped and gathered strength, and the Shadow Demon will be hiding in the dark and watching. We will set off as soon as possible, follow the ancient road to the hinterland of the mountains and rivers, sort out the earth's time sequence, save the people in all directions, and look for opportunities to repair the Time Sequence Jade.
